description: Fork of exp021 (joint qk_lut tph=1024 input_nap=4 output_nap=64, per-head out_proj partition, β2=0.95). Only change: bit_lut_latent_init_std 0.001 -> 0.1. Tests whether the bit-LUT 'spend first N updates just growing past gate threshold' phase is wasting effective training. Each latent gets ~1/2^input_nap of steps; init=0.001 means most early updates are amplified by saturating gate=0.5·T/(T+|w|)² with T=0.1 — i.e. unit-magnitude. With init=0.1, latents start at gate threshold so updates immediately approximate unit-magnitude effective LR.
